versions.name: Camp Liberty

features.note: One of the few remaining full patrol-cooking camps: patrols collect food from the camp commissary and cook it in their own campsite.
On a peninsula in Lake Courage.
The Day Trek adventure programme for older Scouts.

versions.summary: Laurel Highlands Council's Scouts BSA resident camp at Heritage Reservation, set on a peninsula in Lake Courage. One of the few remaining full patrol-cooking camps, offering 50+ merit badges, a First Year Camper program, and a Day Trek high-adventure option for ages 14 and up.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The reservation-wide summer camp page was read as a second source for the lake and aquatics detail it attributes to this camp.
